import importlib.util
from pathlib import Path
import textwrap
import unittest


REPOSITORY_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
SPEC = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(
    "doctest_under_test", REPOSITORY_ROOT / "doctest.py"
)
doctest = importlib.util.module_from_spec(SPEC)
SPEC.loader.exec_module(doctest)


def raise_with_notes(exception, *notes):
    for note in notes:
        exception.add_note(note)
    raise exception


class ExceptionNotesRegressionTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def run_doctest(self, source):
        source = textwrap.dedent(source)
        test = doctest.DocTestParser().get_doctest(
            source,
            {"raise_with_notes": raise_with_notes},
            "exception_notes",
            __file__,
            0,
        )
        return doctest.DocTestRunner().run(test, out=lambda output: None)

    def assert_doctest_result(self, source, *, failed, attempted=1):
        result = self.run_doctest(source)
        self.assertEqual(result.failed, failed)
        self.assertEqual(result.attempted, attempted)

    def test_ordinary_exception_note(self):
        self.assert_doctest_result(
            """
            >>> raise_with_notes(ValueError("bad value"), "check the input")
            Traceback (most recent call last):
            ...
            ValueError: bad value
            check the input
            """,
            failed=0,
        )

    def test_multiple_exception_notes(self):
        self.assert_doctest_result(
            """
            >>> raise_with_notes(ValueError("bad value"), "first note", "second note")
            Traceback (most recent call last):
            ...
            ValueError: bad value
            first note
            second note
            """,
            failed=0,
        )

    def test_incorrect_expected_note_fails(self):
        self.assert_doctest_result(
            """
            >>> raise_with_notes(ValueError("bad value"), "actual note")
            Traceback (most recent call last):
            ...
            ValueError: bad value
            incorrect note
            """,
            failed=1,
        )

    def test_syntax_error_family_notes_ignore_location_decoration(self):
        for exception_type in (SyntaxError, IndentationError, TabError):
            with self.subTest(exception_type=exception_type.__name__):
                source = f'''\
                >>> raise_with_notes(
                ...     {exception_type.__name__}(
                ...         "bad syntax",
                ...         ("actual_source.py", 7, 5, "x +\\n"),
                ...     ),
                ...     "syntax note",
                ... )
                Traceback (most recent call last):
                ...
                {exception_type.__name__}: bad syntax
                syntax note
                '''
                self.assert_doctest_result(source, failed=0)

    def test_incorrect_syntax_error_note_fails(self):
        self.assert_doctest_result(
            """
            >>> raise_with_notes(
            ...     SyntaxError(
            ...         "bad syntax",
            ...         ("actual_source.py", 7, 5, "x +\\n"),
            ...     ),
            ...     "actual syntax note",
            ... )
            Traceback (most recent call last):
            ...
            SyntaxError: bad syntax
            incorrect syntax note
            """,
            failed=1,
        )

    def test_exception_without_notes_is_unchanged(self):
        self.assert_doctest_result(
            """
            >>> raise ValueError("bad value")
            Traceback (most recent call last):
            ...
            ValueError: bad value
            """,
            failed=0,
        )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
